headline: Bank of Japan Governor Ueda Reasserts Resolve to Keep Raising Interest Rates
summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated the central bank's commitment to raising interest rates, noting that underlying financial conditions remain loose and inflation needs anchoring around the 2% target.
why: Bank of Japan monetary policy shifts dictate Japanese government bond yields, domestic liquidity, and the valuation of the Japanese yen in global currency markets.

impacts.name: Japanese yen
impacts.why: Commitment to further interest rate hikes supports currency valuation and tightens domestic monetary conditions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Governor Ueda's explicit guidance regarding ongoing rate hikes reinforced expectations of tighter monetary policy, supporting domestic financial assets and the currency.
